note: The pig these scripts and tests target: the same major.minor, at least this patch. Raise it with the SDK bump (scripts/pig-bin.mjs). `release` pins the public PiG release CI downloads (scripts/fetch-pig.mjs) and the source commit its Piglet builds need; the sha256 values are the release's SHA256SUMS, checked against a download of each archive. Re-pin with scripts/pin-pig-release.mjs <version>.
